name: OpenVibe.Live

site.name: Live
site.what: Live streaming from a browser, OBS or a phone, with restreaming, clips, VODs, chat games and channel points.

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP (uptime, chat connections); it checks nothing else (/api/ready flips only when every boot step the request paths need is done)

drains: transcription, timeline-capture and media-analysis children killed; RobotStreamer passthroughs ended
readiness flips to not ready; job loops stopped; SSE streams closed
after 300 ms: restreams, recorder, call/chat/control/broadcast WebSockets, JSMPEG, SFU and RTMP stopped; analytics and the database closed
shutdown.note: forced exit 5 s after the 300 ms notice delay; the listening socket belongs to openvibe-live.socket, so new HTTP connections queue through the restart while WebSockets, WHIP, RTMP and WebRTC sessions end

resumes.what: streams still marked live get a fresh heartbeat (broadcasters have 5 minutes to reconnect); their restreams, chat relays, RobotStreamer and AI bots start again
VOD/clip transcripts left processing go back to retry (progress kept); earlier failures get a fresh retry ladder

unsent stream events and index documents in the transactional outbox (server/events/stream-events.js) go to OpenVibe.Events; staged chat-table changes queued in chat_staged_outbox go to OpenVibe.Chat when CHAT_AUTHORITY=chat
OpenVibe.Events redelivers media.vod.*, media.clip.*, media.storage.* and network.user.token_valid_after that were pending during the stop (at least once, deduped by event_id)

conditions: automatic: deploy/scripts/deploy.sh switches back to the previous release when /api/ready does not answer within READY_TIMEOUT (90 s) after the restart (exit 3)
manual: deploy/scripts/deploy.sh --rollback switches to the previous release
rollback.window: automatic during the 90 s readiness wait; manual while the previous release is still in releases/ and no blocker applies
blockers: ledger migrations (server/db/migrations.js) are forward-only and may transform data (001_vibes_decimal_to_bits multiplied Vibes amounts by 100): a release from before one misreads the data
with BILLING_AUTHORITY=billing, a release from before the money-authority tripwire would write the legacy money tables
with a staged chat table at chat (chat_table_authority), a release from before server/chat/chat-tables.js would write it directly

claims.what: write authority over money and over each staged chat table
claims.holder: BILLING_AUTHORITY (env) and app_state chat_table_authority, per table
claims.expires: only when an operator hands it over (POST /internal/chat-tables/:table; the Billing cutover runbook)
claims.fencing: a database-level tripwire throws on any write to the money tables when BILLING_AUTHORITY=billing; chat-tables write() sends a staged table's writes to Chat once it is at chat

notes: Still hosts chat, ingest, money and AI authorities until Waves 6-13; paste authority moved to Community (W5).
